reviewSamples.author: Z
reviewSamples.text: Needed a custom display/platform box and Yorgeli did such an amazing job! Made sure everything was perfectly made and exactly as I wanted, beyond my expectations. Thank you!!!

reviewSamples.author: EMILIO D'ARCE
reviewSamples.text: YORGELI IS THE BEST OF THE BEST IN ANYTHING THAT INVOLVES CARPENTRY! I DEFINITELY RECOMMEND THIS INDIVIDUAL TO ANYONE THAT NEEDS THIS TYPE OF WORK DONE EITHER FOR THEIR HOME OR BUSINESS! YOU ARE IN GOOD HANDS!

reviewSamples.author: Lily Borrero
reviewSamples.text: I highly recommend Shalom Custom Home Solution; they offer quality, excellent customer service, and fast service, pleased and happy with my walk-in closet.

reviewSamples.author: Roice Galardy
reviewSamples.text: Amazing job! Very skilled carpenter, great quality work, and fair prices. I'm very happy with the results.

reviewSamples.author: Jemima Molina Olmo
reviewSamples.text: Amazing pieces. Yorgelis is really perfectionist and does an awesome job. I totally recommend him.
